Juneteenth isn’t just a celebration, it’s also a day of action.

This year, St. Louis came together to build our movement to fight for reparations, an end to racism and discrimination, and a future where Black communities can thrive.

On August 4th, we'll go back to Congress to make that future a reality.

CBTU has done incredible work advocating for the rights of Black workers in the St. Louis area for decades.

Together, we’re building a movement to fight for livable wages, fair working conditions, the right to organize, and more.
